Database Backup

A consistent point-in-time snapshot of the SQLite database (events, bans, settings). Safe to run at any time — writes continue uninterrupted. To restore: stop the container and replace data/logfort.db with the downloaded file.

Alert Rules

Responder

read-only
Loading…
Responder backend and jail are set via environment variables (LOGFORT_RESPONDER_BACKEND, LOGFORT_FAIL2BAN_JAIL). Restart the container to apply changes.

fail2ban — SSH jail

live
Ban an IP after this many wrong passwords within the window. Values are read live from fail2ban; saving applies them immediately — no restart needed.
Managed jail: sshd. LogFort re-applies these values automatically if fail2ban restarts.

Auto-ban

disabled
events per
Any IP exceeding this number of failed password attempts within the window is banned automatically. Only real attempts count (one per wrong password) — auxiliary log lines and accepted logins never do.
Auto-bans are lifted automatically after this long. Attacker IPs are mostly dynamic — permanent bans slowly fill the firewall with stale addresses.

Comma- or newline-separated. These addresses are protected from auto-ban and manual bans immediately after saving — add your home/office IP here.

Active banning is disabled. Set LOGFORT_RESPONDER_ENABLED=true in your Docker Compose and restart to enable auto-ban and manual ban/unban.
